subject: Greenlight Review: Network & Ops smoke + observability (go/no-go)
messages:
From: Anita Rao <anita@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Greenlight Review: Network & Ops smoke + observability (initial checklist)

Marissa / team —

Thanks for your notes this week. We're on track to hit our cutover window next Monday (2026-11-01). Before we give a final greenlight from ACME, can you confirm the following network & ops acceptance items are complete? I've listed the ones we're tracking on our side:

- IP routing: private VPC peering established, routes propagated to both colo racks
- NAT/GW: outbound NAT verified for model telemetry endpoints (10.4.2.0/24)
- Firewall: egress rules for model telemetry and metrics (TCP 443, 9090) created
- Observability: metrics ingestion validated to our Datadog with tags (env:prod, account:acme)
- KV cache sanity: sample cache hit-rate >= 45% on 20k token prefix workload
- Rollback plan: documented rollback with playbook and time-to-recover estimate

Attachments: redwood-network-diagram-v2.pdf (PDF) — please confirm the NAT placement and whether an additional SNAT pool will be needed.

Proposed final verification slot: Mon 2026-11-01 10:00 PT for a 30-minute smoke with you driving, then we can escalate to go/no-go at 11:00 PT.

Short answers are fine — we just need explicit sign-off on the bullets above.

Appreciate it,
Anita Rao
Senior IT Program Manager
ACME Analytics
--
ACME Ops: ops@acmeanalytics.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenlight Review: Network & Ops smoke + observability (initial checklist)

Anita —

Thanks for the clear checklist. Quick status from our side ahead of the Monday slot:

- IP routing: Confirmed. Private VPC peering is active; routes propagated. (See diagram attached.)
- NAT/GW: Primary NAT in colo rack A, SNAT pool allocated (10.4.2.100-10.4.2.140). We'll add a secondary pool in rack B if you require additional ephemeral addresses — please advise.
- Firewall: Egress rules pushed; restricted to the listed telemetry endpoints.
- Observability: We have a short-lived metrics bridge to Datadog. Preliminary ingestion tests passed (latency < 5s for gauge metrics).
- KV cache sanity: Running a 20k token prefix run now; I'll share the CSV results immediately after completion.
- Rollback plan: Draft playbook attached (kv-cache-acceptance.md). Reversion can be done in two steps: config toggle -> model pin rollback. Estimated RTO 12 minutes.

We can run the smoke at 10:00 PT on Nov 1 as proposed. I'll be on the call along with Karthik (network lead) and Dev (runtime ops). If ACME prefers a later slot (closer to the 22:00 UTC cutover), we can shift.

Attachments: smoke-results-2026-10-30.csv (CSV), redwood-network-diagram-v2.pdf (PDF), kv-cache-acceptance.md (MD)

Marissa Cole
Principal Product Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Anita Rao <anita@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenlight Review: Network & Ops smoke + observability (initial checklist)

Marissa / Anita —

Quick summary of the network verification I ran this morning (details below). I validated both control-plane and data-plane paths for the service endpoints and ran the sample workload you requested.

Results:
- Control-plane: API reachability from private subnets -> PASS (TCP 443, handshake < 120ms)
- Egress NAT: Verified SNAT pool working from both colo racks; no address exhaustion observed during 5k concurrent connections test -> PASS
- Firewall/NACLs: No denied egress entries for telemetry addresses; dropped packets < 0.05% (expected)
- Observability bridge: Packet capture shows HTTPS POSTs to datadog ingestion endpoint with expected payload tags -> PASS
- KV cache: Local sample run produced 48% hit-rate with the provided workload (attached CSV). Edge-case: cold-starts for replica 3 caused a transient 6% latency bump on token 1-50 — mitigations: pre-warm replica 3 during the first 10 minutes of traffic or enable async prefetch.

Notes and action items:
1) Recommend enabling the secondary SNAT pool in rack B during the cutover window as a live reserve — this is a fast toggle and low risk.
2) We'll add a short pre-warm job to the runbook to avoid the cold-start bump. Script name: prewarm-replicas.sh (referenced in playbook).
3) Observability: increase gauge retention for the first 2 hours post-cutover to 1s granularity for the model-level request metrics.

I'll be on the call 10:00 PT Monday and will run the network checklist live. Attaching the smoke CSV: smoke-results-2026-10-30.csv.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Network & Systems Lead
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenlight Review: Network & Ops smoke + observability (initial checklist)

Anita / Tom —

Greenlight: we are GO for the Monday evening cutover window (22:00 UTC) with the following confirmations and small contingencies:

- Network: Karthik validated control-plane and data-plane; secondary SNAT pool will be staged in rack B and will remain on standby (toggle-able within 60s).
- Observability: bridge to ACME Datadog validated. Redwood will increase metric ingestion granularity for first 2 hours post-cutover.
- KV cache: hit-rate 48% on the sample workload; pre-warm job added to runbook to avoid replica cold-start latency.
- Rollback: runbook tested in staging; RTO estimate 12 minutes.

Final asks for ACME before we commence cutover at 22:00 UTC:
1) Confirm you are OK with the staged SNAT pool (we will not enable it unless we see address pressure).
2) Confirm an ACME on-call escalation contact for the first 90 minutes after cutover (name/number).

If we don't hear objections by 17:00 PT today we'll treat this as final sign-off and proceed. Thanks for the partnership — looking forward to a smooth transition.

Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference
